5744-6991-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
5744-6991-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Roshan, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Donnie & April token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

222-527-5147-8296.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-5147-8296.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

728-6854--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
728-6854--5--195.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Host of the Hereafter trigger.
Resolve Host of the Hereafter's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 1.
Repeat.

4067-4435-6480-7824.easyPrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
4067-4435-6480-7824.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, tapping Rescue Leopard.
Rescue Leopard triggers, causing you to discard a card and draw four cards.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Rescue Leopard.
Repeat.

2626-4659-4986--44.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the artifact
Activate Salvager of Ruin by sacrificing it, returning the artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Salvager of Ruin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4399-4770-5789-6626.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Lifecreed Duo trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Lifecreed Duo trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4770-5789-6626.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

215-1322-3443.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven creature cards in your graveyard.
215-1322-3443.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding an amount of {B} or {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Deathbloom Ritualist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Deathbloom Ritualist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-1322-3443.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {B}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Deathbloom Ritualist

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1169-5475-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Forensic Researcher.
Activate one of the Forensic Researcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Forensic Researcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

465-2150-6798.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes from exile to the battlefield.
When Hero of the Dunes enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 3.

628-2193-5330.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Chainbreaker.
When Chainbreaker dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Atog ability
Repeat.

4476-5670-6705.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
4476-5670-6705.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1369-3990-7086.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that can tap to produce {U}.
1369-3990-7086.description:
Cast Touch of Vitae by paying {2}{G}, targeting Incubation Druid.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental by paying {U}, causing it to gain Incubation Druid's activated abilities until end of turn.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Incubation Druid's ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Incubation Druid's ability granted to it by Touch of Vitae by paying {0}, untapping Quicksilver Elemental.
Repeat from step 2.

380-2557-2726-2972.description:
Cast Miirym either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{G}{U}{R} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Reflections of Littjara triggers, copying the Miirym spell, creating two token copies of Miirym.
Put all but one legendary Miirym into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Miirym tokens enter, Ganax triggers twice, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the original Miirym spell. Choose to put the nontoken Miirym into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Each Miirym you control and Ganax trigger,
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve a Miirym trigger, creating two token copies of Miirym that aren't legendary.
When the Miirym tokens enter, Ganax triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 8 for each remaining trigger, if applicable.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 11 until you control no Treasures and/or you have enough mana to cast Miirym from the command zone.
Repeat from step 1.
380-2557-2726-2972.notes: The starting cost assume you haven't cost Miirym from the command zone this game. You can perform the combo if you've cast Miirym this game from the command zone, but will need additional mana to do so.

3532-4997-5078-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control another Knight and/or Merfolk.
3532-4997-5078-6747.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Knight and/or Merfolk you control.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2921-5571-6922--6.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
2921-5571-6922--6.description:
Activate Coveted Falcon by paying {1}{U}, turning it face up.
Coveted Falcon triggers, causing an opponent to gain control of Blightbeetle and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3394-4929-5220.description:
Cast Cryptic Trilobite by paying {0}.
Cryptic Trilobite enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Weatherlight Compleated.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Cryptic Trilobite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Weatherlight Compleated trigger, causing you to put a phyresis counter on it and draw a card, thus drawing Omarthis from your library.
Repeat.

2404-5090-6474.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven creatures.
2404-5090-6474.description:
Activate the creature with Singing Bell Strike attached using Gaea's Cradle's ability by tapping it, adding at least seven {G}.
Activate Singing Bell Strike by paying {6}, untapping the creature.
Repeat.

Cast Astelli Reclaimer for its warp cost by paying {2}{W}.
When Astelli Reclaimer enters, it triggers twice, returning Lion's Eye Diamond and Lotus Bloom from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Lotus Bloom by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Astelli Raclaimer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
215-2397-3390-3518-6865.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can continue the combo returning any noncreature, nonland permanents with mana value 5 or less. You should instead cast Astelli Reclaimer for its normal mana cost in this case.

2034-4484-4871-6351.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
2034-4484-4871-6351.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ebondeath, adding {C}{C}.
When Ebondeath dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

488-641-1414-1482-4986.notablePrerequisites: One of either Jeweled Lotus or Lotus Petal must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-641-1414-1482-4986.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Kroxa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Kroxa enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Kroxa trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Kroxa trigger, causing each opponent to discard a card and lose 3 life if they didn't discard a nonland card.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1778-4050-4763-6290.description:
Cast Lightwheel Enhancements either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {W}, attaching it to Memnite.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Memnite, adding {W}.
When Memnite dies, Koll triggers, returning Memnite from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1322-2457-4289-4772.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

801-1069-4763-6068.notablePrerequisites: You control three or more artifacts, including an Equipment except Dissection Tools.
801-1069-4763-6068.description:
Activate an equipment except Dissection Tools' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Impulsive Pilferer.
Activate Dissection Tools by sacrificing Impulsive Pilferer, targeting Koll.
When Impulsive Pilferer dies, it and Koll trigger.
Resolve the Impulsive Pilferer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dissection Tools ability, attaching it to Koll.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Impulsive Pilferer by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

277-3322-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites:
Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
277-3322-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Tiller Engine and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Everywhere.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nikya of the Old Ways triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

618-2724-4647.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Wormfang Manta with haste.
When Wormfang Manta enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to skip your next turn.
At the beginning of your end step, Kiki-Jiki triggers, causing you to sacrifice Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability triggers twice, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your first extra turn, skipping it due to Wormfang Manta's trigger from step 2.
Move to your second extra turn.
Repeat.

1636-3652-3801-5220.notablePrerequisites:
Ragamuffyn does not have summoning sickness.
You have no cards in hand.
1636-3652-3801-5220.description:
Activate Ragamuffyn by tapping it and sacrificing Ornithopter.
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ornithopter on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Ragamuffyn ability, causing you to draw Ornithopter from your library.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
When Ornithopter enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

49-1657-1799-2034.notablePrerequisites: Murderous Redcap does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
49-1657-1799-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Murderous Redcap, adding {C}{C}.
When Murderous Redcap dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Murderous Redcap enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Murderous Redcap, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Murderous Redcap on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Murderous Redcap into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Murderous Redcap enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.

308-688-2835-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
308-688-2835-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Haunted Dead, adding {B}.
Fecundity triggers, drawing you a card.
Activate Haunted Dead by paying {B} and discarding two cards, returning Haunted Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Haunted Dead enters the battlefield, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Spirit creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Fecundity triggers, drawing you a card.
Repeat.

3545-4929-5189.notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least four +1/+1 counters.
3545-4929-5189.description:
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Cryptic Trilobite, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
The Saproling enters the battlefield, triggering Sigil, putting two +1/+1 counters on the Saproling.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a Saproling, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
The Saproling enters the battlefield, triggering Sigil Captain, putting two +1/+1 counters on the Saproling.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a Saproling token, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 4.

957-1702-3212.description:
Activate Jace's zero loyalty ability, putting Time Stretch on top of your library.
Move to your next turn.
On your next draw step, when you draw Time Stretch, reveal it due to Kefnet's ability, making a copy that costs {2} less to cast.
Cast the copy for {6}{U}{U}, granting you two extra turns.
